response.sql: WITH matched_fees_orders AS (SELECT f.feerate, f.rebrate, o.mktnote FROM fees f INNER JOIN orders o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault), pair_avg_net_fees AS (SELECT mktnote, AVG(feerate - rebrate) AS avg_net_fee_rate FROM matched_fees_orders GROUP BY mktnote), benchmark_calc AS (SELECT AVG(avg_net_fee_rate) AS benchmark_rate FROM pair_avg_net_fees WHERE avg_net_fee_rate IS NOT NULL), above_benchmark AS (SELECT p.avg_net_fee_rate, b.benchmark_rate FROM pair_avg_net_fees p, benchmark_calc b WHERE b.benchmark_rate IS NOT NULL AND p.avg_net_fee_rate > b.benchmark_rate) SELECT AVG(avg_net_fee_rate) AS avg_of_avg_net_fees, AVG(avg_net_fee_rate - benchmark_rate) AS avg_excess_over_benchmark FROM above_benchmark
